skill.summary: Optimizes LinkedIn headlines, About sections, experience framing, and keyword use to enhance profile clarity and recruiter discoverability without fabrications.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the LinkedIn Profile Optimizer skill.
- Enhances headline, about section, experience descriptions, and recruiter keyword discoverability.
- Respects user privacy, forbids fabrication of credentials or promises of recruiter outreach.
- Outputs include multiple headline options, About section rewrite, experience suggestions, keyword map, and a profile checklist.
- Designed for users aiming to improve their LinkedIn presence for target roles in networking and personal branding.
